recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not make a FHIR-27800 source edit unless the work group reopens the later all-UCUM component quantity decision.
issue_request: FHIR-27800 asked that the ucum-vitals-common binding on Observation.component.value[x] apply only to the valueQuantity slice and not to other component value datatypes such as CodeableConcept, with OO later resolving it Persuasive and preapplied for R6.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly named FHIR-27800. Related history changed the same binding family: FHIR-27911 relaxed earlier vital-sign unit bindings, FHIR-43353 moved/relaxed quantity-specific bindings, and FHIR-47136 component profiling work left a distinct Observation.component.value[x]:valueQuantity Quantity slice.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini and the Observation Vital Signs IG includes StructureDefinition/vitalsigns, so structuredefinition-profile-vitalsigns.xml is build-scope source. Later FHIR-44721/FHIR-47136 decisions changed the component valueQuantity binding from ucum-vitals-common to http://unitsofmeasure.org/vs to support downstream UCUM units outside the small vital-signs set; those related issues already have combined-branch reconcile commits.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source has no binding on unsliced Observation.component.value[x], and the only component unit binding is on the Observation.component.value[x]:valueQuantity slice typed as Quantity. Re-narrowing that binding to ucum-vitals-common would conflict with later applied decisions.
